tests.scope: Pinned Python protocol with mocked RPC/allocator/IPC/restore and real CPU PyCapsules

verified: Private call globals do not modify original native module
Same-call allocation base, bytes, offsets and replica recorded
RPC uses remaining deadline; completion response checked before tensor wrappers
Store request and worker allocation cleanup obligations separated

history.resolution: Separate Store request and cleanup flags, failure regressions and explicit documentation
history.finding: Worker cleanup false does not imply no Store side effects

limitations: No native runtime or GPU ABI/DMA validation
Python deadline does not cancel native or filesystem blocks
Failure needs guarded worker/context and own Store disposal; no cleanup success claimed
